text: mode manager Entering and leaving modes is initiated by a mode manager. A mode manager is defined by having a provide mode switch port or a providedModeGroup ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype. A mode manager might be either an application mode manager or a Basic Software Module that provides a service including mode switches, like the ECU State Manager. See also section 2.2.
